title: Rescue Tech At The 145th Airlift Wing
description: Air Force and Civilian Firefighters participate in the Rescue Tech One course at the 145th Airlift Wing. The North Carolina Air National Guard is the only Guard base in the country that conducts both Rescue Tech One and Rescue Tech Two, and also accepts Active Duty, National Guard, Reserve and civilians.
keywords: North Carolina Air National Guard, 145th Airlift Wing, Rescue Tech One, AIr Force, firefighters
unit_name: 145th Airlift Wing, North Carolina Air National Guard
credit: Staff Sgt. Sonia Clark, Airman 1st Class Juan Paz

transcript.text: We're the only guard base in the entire
country that runs Rescue Tech One,
Rescue Tech Two. We can take in
Guardsmen. We can take in Reservist.
We can take in Active duty members. We can take
in civilians. It's also gonna give
them a state certification with
reciprocity in whatever state they're
in. If they're in Florida, they go back
to Florida , they get reciprocity from
North Carolina, and they now have a state
and federal certification. The civilian fire departments
that these guys and girls may work for
on the outside, it's a big deal to
have those certifications that are both
state and federal.
I love this kind of training. I love to
challenge myself in ways that I've
never been challenged before . So it's
been it's been a lot of fun out here .
